verdict.rationale: ReelMimic builds videos shot by shot, with separate agents per part and per-shot review. Creators can leave time-coded notes on the finished video or request changes in chat, which implies targeted segment revisions. However, the docs never state that a fix regenerates only the affected segment without re-rendering the whole video, and the 'Extending' section is about adding styles and engines, not lengthening clips. Missing for 10: explicit segment-only regeneration that avoids a full re-render, any clip-extension capability, and hands-on corroboration of targeted re-renders.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video

citations.quote: When it's done, scrub to any second and type a note. Send them all at once.
Up to 6 work on different parts of the video. Each finished shot goes to a new agent for review
If you want changes, say so in the chat on the right.
The Production line tab shows where each character and each part of the video is, with the review screenshots.
